title: Tweeter
body: A 1-inch aluminium dome in a shallow waveguide, set in a brass ring.

title: Woofer
body: A 6.5-inch paper-composite cone on a cast frame.

title: Port
body: A slot along the bottom of the front, so the speaker can sit near a wall.

title: Cabinet
body: Solid hardwood, 19 mm thick, braced inside so the box stays quiet.

title: Crossover
body: Air-core coils and film capacitors, hand-soldered behind the back panel.
